findings.summary: Every requirement R1-R5 appears verbatim in DESIGN.md, mission.json and architecture.md section 0, and is mapped to tasks and checks with nothing narrowed. R1 maps to T1 and T6 (T1-test, T1-build, T1-behavior, T1-visual, plus the T6 checks). R2 maps to T2 and T6 (T2-test, T2-behavior, T2-visual). R3 maps to T3 and T6 (T3-test, T3-behavior, T3-visual). R4 maps to T4 and T6 (T4-test, T4-behavior, T4-visual). R5 maps to T5 and T6 (T5-test, T5-behavior, T5-visual-375, T5-visual-1280, T6-build). T6 covers R1-R5 at both 375x700 and 1280x800 with test, behavior and visual checks. Together these cover every web-app profile kind (test, build, behavior, visual).

The sha256 of checks/browser-check.mjs (d0fa1c02...6413e) and checks/build-check.mjs (80b37258...bcf7) match the hashes recorded in architecture.md section 8. The PLANS map in browser-check.mjs (line 1075) matches the 23 contract check ids and kinds one-to-one, as listed in section 6.2. All scenario functions named in the architecture exist: scenarioAdd/Complete/Filter/Persist/Layout/Reach/Journey and visualAdd/Done/Filter/Persist/Layout.

For the current product 10fb2745...bac6 and contract digest 161448e6...03fa, exactly one record exists for each of the 23 checks. All 23 have exit_code 0, and no report in evidence contains a FAIL assertion. The sample T6-test report shows real Chromium 153 run through AUTODEV_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE (/opt/pw-browsers/chromium).

Some status notes in architecture.md are out of date. Section 8.1 says the checks have not been executed and are UNVERIFIED. Section 8.2 says the amended check has not yet been run in Chromium. Section 9 still mentions an unresolved CLAIMED burst lease. Current evidence shows all 23 checks recorded and passing under the amended hash. These are historical notes, not a narrowing of any requirement, and this read-only pass left them unchanged.

architecture.md section 8.2 says the earlier T4-visual FAIL (run 9ce69043, superseded browser-check hash) is kept in .autodev/evidence. Only the PNG captures and a runner-9ce69043 state file ({"state":"stopped"}) are present. There is no check record JSON or report JSON for that run, and failure.json has no T4-visual FAIL event. The failure stays visible only through the architecture narrative and the PNGs. Separately, failure.json still shows 6 UNVERIFIED review-persistence events (assess.mjs exit 2, 'No live SDK capture') for T1-T6. Those events have not been removed.

Assumptions A1-A8 are kept in their own section (architecture.md section 10) and none of them narrows R1-R5. A5 (localStorage unavailable) is handled defensively with no dedicated check; that case is outside R4's literal wording.
